issue.title: Enhancement: Add CRC counter check on snappi related test cases

failure.body: ### Is it platform specific generic ### Importance or Severity Critical ### Description of the enhancement The snappi test case will fail when there is CRC errors on the link between TGEN and DUT. The issue is the error message will be different for each test case, it takes time to investigate and identify it's because of link CRC error. The request is to add a CRC error check in snappi test cases if packet loss is seen. This can save time to troubleshoot where the packet loss are. Here is one recent failure due to CRC error: snappi_tests/pfc/test_pfc_no_congestion_throughput.py::test_single_lossless_prio[multidut_port_info0-port_map0] FAILED [ 83%] ``` test_check = test_def['test_check'] if (not test_check['loss_expected']): # Check for loss packets on IXIA and DUT. > pytest_assert(test_stats['tgen_loss_pkts'] == 0, 'Loss seen on TGEN') E Failed: Loss seen on TGEN BG_FLOW_AGGR_RATE_PERCENT = 50 DATA_FLOW_DURATION_SEC = 304 PAUSE_FLOW_DUR_BASE_SEC = 300 SNAPPI_POLL_DELAY_SEC = 60 TEST_FLOW_AGGR_RATE_PERCENT = 99.5 all_flow_names = ['Test Flow Prio 3 Stream 0'] ``` ### Current Behavior no CRC check in test case ### Proposed Behavior check port CRC errors if there are packet loss detected.
